The Recursive Agents Hackathon
Shack15, San Francisco, CASat, Oct 17 at 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM (PDT)

Build a team of agents you can walk away from.

During the PyTorch Conference in San Francisco, build agents that can take a goal and run with it. Let them make the plan, spin up sub-agents, delegate work, communicate with each other, check their own progress, recover when things break, and keep going.

Get a head start. Crusoe is hosting Field Day the day before the hackathon. You'll join a random team and race to take a model from raw data to production. Friday, Oct 16, 1-5pm. Spots are limited, register here!

Push beyond the one-shot agent into persistent loops that rarely need you involved: agents building teams and handling delegation, memory, and long-running inference that can keep operating after you walk away until the work is complete

Build on Crusoe Managed Inference and put leading open models, including NVIDIA’s Nemotron family, into production on high-performance NVIDIA infrastructure.

Compete to win $25,000 in cash prizes and an NVIDIA RTX 5090.

Note: This event is fully in-person in San Francisco. Teams may have up to four members. All attendees must apply and be approved to attend.

Register

About Event

​NOTE: By registering for the Luma, you are submitting an application to participate. We will reach out on a rolling basis to let you know whether you've been accepted. There are a limited number of devices, we can support up to 200 participants.

​This event is sponsored by Meta, Qualcomm, GitHub, Open Intelligence Foundation, and the PyTorch Foundation.

​Join developers, researchers, and builders for the upcoming ExecuTorch Hackathon on October 17 -18 at Founder’s Inc., officially part of Open Source AI Week 2026.

​Hosted in collaboration with Qualcomm, Meta, GitHub, the PyTorch Foundation, and Open Intelligence Foundation, this hands-on event will challenge teams to build innovative AI experiences powered by ExecuTorch—an open-source framework for deploying and running PyTorch models efficiently on edge and on-device hardware.

​Participants will work in teams of 3–5 people and select one of three tracks outlined below. Each team will receive a device from their selected track to use during the event. Builders will also get access to GitHub Copilot Pro+ to support their builds.

​Compute Track

​Build AI applications optimized for the Copilot+ PC powered by Snapdragon® X Elite processors, exploring the potential of powerful, efficient on-device AI computing.

​Mobile + XR Track

​Create AI-powered experiences for the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra powered by Snapdragon 8 Elite and Samsung Galaxy XR powered by Snapdragon® XR2+ Gen 2 processor, with a focus on mobile intelligence, immersive interaction, and multimodal applications.

​IoT Track

​Develop intelligent edge and embedded applications using the Arduino® VENTUNO™ Q boards, combining on-device AI with real-time sensing, control, and connected experiences. Choose from an assortment of modulinos and accessories to complete your project (available on a first come, first served basis).

​To participate, interested teams must select a track, form a team of 3–5, and submit a project proposal by October 4. Selected teams will be announced by October 7.

​Prizes

​The top team in each track will receive a prize package for every member of the team: Meta AI glasses and an Arduino® UNO™ Q. Build a standout project, demonstrate the potential of on-device AI, and take home hardware to continue exploring the edge.

GitHub will also award a one-year subscription to Copilot Pro to the winner.

​Whether you are an experienced edge AI developer or eager to explore the future of open-source, on-device intelligence, the ExecuTorch Hackathon is an opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and build with the latest hardware and software across compute, mobile, XR, and IoT.

​Questions? Join our Discord!
Ask questions about the event, connect with other participants, form a team, receive event announcements, and stay up to date throughout the hackathon.

​👉 Join here: Join Discord Server

​Bring your ideas. Build with ExecuTorch. Help shape the future of open-source, on device AI.

​

​About Open Intelligence Foundation

​The Open Intelligence Foundation is a community-first nonprofit founded to protect, strengthen, and advance open-source AI, open models, and open science. Supported by a large community of volunteers and organizations, it takes a bottom-up approach to collaboration, working with academia and researchers to support research, development, and education in open-source AI. The foundation also leads Open Source AI Week, a community-run initiative celebrating open-source AI.

​About Founders, Inc.
Founders, Inc. backs early-stage founders in emerging tech with first checks and 55,000 sq. ft. of lab space in San Francisco's Fort Mason. They run year-round programs to help ambitious builders to go from early stage to scalable companies.

​

​Snapdragon and Qualcomm branded products are products of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and/or its subsidiaries. Arduino and VENTUNO are trademarks or registered trademarks of Arduino S.r.l.

About Event
​The Builder Base: Buildathon

​Your idea. Your stack. Your build.

​Welcome to The Builder Base: Buildathon — a one-day gathering in San Francisco for engineers, AI builders, founders, designers, and technology professionals who want to spend a full day turning ideas into working products.

​Builder Base is built around one simple idea: give builders the space, tools, people, and time to build.

​Whether you're experimenting with an AI agent, launching a developer tool, creating an enterprise workflow, building a data product, automating a painful process, or working on something completely unconventional, this is your base for the day.

​Come with an idea, a problem, a technology you want to explore — or nothing more than the desire to build. Find teammates, get feedback from experienced builders, learn from industry experts, and ship something you're proud of.

​Event Details

​When: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM, 30 October 2026
Where: San Francisco, CA
Format: One-day, in-person buildathon
Who: Engineers, AI Builders, Founders, Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, and Technology Professionals
Theme: Open-ended — Build what matters

​What to Expect

​A full day dedicated to building

​Turn an idea into a functional prototype

​Collaborate with engineers, founders, designers, and AI practitioners

​Meet potential teammates and future collaborators

​Mentorship and guidance from experienced industry professionals

​Access to modern AI tools, APIs, platforms, and developer resources

​Partner credits, challenges, and special prizes

​Live product demos and project showcases

​Networking with San Francisco's technology and startup community

​Food, refreshments, swag, and prizes

​What Can You Build?

​Anything worth building.

​Build an AI application, autonomous agent, developer tool, enterprise workflow, data platform, automation system, productivity tool, consumer product, infrastructure project, or an idea nobody has tried before.

​There are no prescribed problem statements and no requirement to build around a particular technology.

​Find a problem. Build the solution. Ship it.

​You can arrive with a fully formed idea or figure it out once you get there. The goal is to spend the day building, experimenting, learning, and turning an idea into something real.

​Who Should Join?

​The Builder Base is for people who make things.

​Whether you're an experienced software engineer, an AI developer exploring agentic systems, a founder testing a new idea, a product manager turning a concept into a prototype, a designer bringing an experience to life, or a student and early-career developer looking for your next challenge — you're welcome.

​You don't need to be an expert. You just need to be ready to build.

​Come with an idea. Leave with a build.

​🛑 AI is moving beyond text. The next generation of products will reason across images, video, audio, voice, documents, and real-world data—not just prompts and responses. This hackathon is about building for that future. Join us at AWS Builder Loft on October 23 for a one-day Multi-Modal Hackathon, bringing together builders, researchers, founders, and investors to ship products that combine multiple forms of intelligence into something people can actually use. This is a build-first event. Come with an idea, find a teammate, and leave with a working demo. Register here for AWS Builders Loft Entrance: https://events.builder.aws.com/W4PEkn

​Loft Policy

​All guests must be 18+ and present a valid government-issued physical photo ID at check-in (digital IDs will not be accepted). Scooters and bikes are not permitted in any Amazon building; no on-site parking available.

​Format 2-4 builders per team One-day hackathon Working demo required Technical credits and resources will be provided Additional sponsor and integration requirements will be announced Judges:

Full track details and judging criteria will be announced soon. Prizes & Opportunities 🏆 Cash Prizes 1st: $500 2nd: $300 3rd: $200 Prize pool and placements to be announced. 💰 Beta Fund Fellowship Standout founders and teams may be invited to interview for Beta Fund's Fellowship and potential investment. Partners Chert lets anyone put a realtime AI video agent on a live FaceTime call with one API. We're already powering teams building AI companions, coaches, real-estate, and onboarding agents. Venue 📍 AWS Builder Loft — San Francisco 📅 October 23, 2026 More details on sponsors, tracks, judges, speakers, prizes, and technical requirements coming soon. For now: build something that can see, hear, understand, and act.

​Participants create a clear vision of who they want to become in 10 years — not in a linear way, but in an exponential, ambitious way, similar to how venture investors think about long-term growth.

​GSB/MSx alumni will see how the younger generation learns to think in true Stanford GSB style — with courage, long-term vision, and strategic imagination.

​automating repetitive follow-ups,

The Universal Celebration Hackathon is a celebration of creativity, entrepreneurship, and the next generation of AI-powered companies. Bring your ideas, experiment with new possibilities, and turn your vision into something real.
This hackathon is about more than building a prototype. It’s about imagining what a company looks like when AI agents can work together as a team.
The Challenge
Build a company run by a team of AI agents.
Your challenge is to create an AI-native business or startup where multiple specialized agents work together to build, operate, and grow the company.
Think of your agents as your founding team. You might have a CEO agent defining strategy, a product agent building the product, engineering agents writing code, marketing agents finding customers, sales agents closing deals, finance agents managing the business, and operations or customer-support agents keeping everything running.
The key question is:
What happens when you give an AI team a business to run?
Kylon
Kylon helps you create AI agents that can run business processes. You can turn workflows into agents that understand tasks, use tools, and take actions.
AdaL
AdaL is an automation-first agent harness designed to get more done with less of your time. She combines personality, skills, and memory to become a personalized agent that can work alongside you.
Tenki
Tenki provides sandbox environments, cloud compute, and runners for executing code and workloads. It gives builders a place to experiment, run, and scale their work.
Rocket Ride
Rocket Ride helps developers build AI and data pipelines directly in their IDE. It makes it easier to connect data, AI models, processing steps, and outputs into repeatable workflows.
Flatkey
Flatkey is a unified access layer for AI, connecting teams to 328+ official AI models through one API. It supports models from providers such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, and more, with transparent pricing and automatic failover.
FinChip
FinChip provides agent skills that give AI agents reusable capabilities for performing specific tasks. Skills can help make agents more useful, structured, and consistent.
Prelint
Prelint is your product whisperer, checking every pull request against product specs, business rules, and compliance requirements.
It catches spec drift before code ships, turning product decisions into automated checks within your existing GitHub workflow.
So teams and AI agents can move fast without losing sight of what the product is supposed to do.
What to Build
Build a working prototype of a company powered by a team of collaborating AI agents.
Your project should:
Identify a real problem or opportunity.
Define a clear product, service, or business.
Create multiple AI agents with distinct roles and responsibilities.
Show how your agents communicate, collaborate, and make decisions.
Demonstrate how the agents can actually execute business tasks.
Show how your company could acquire customers, deliver value, and grow.
You can build for consumers, businesses, creators, communities, or any other audience.
Don’t just build an AI feature. Build the beginnings of an AI-native company.
Tracks
Choose one or multiple tracks and build your company within them.
Climate, Sustainability & Impact
Build AI solutions for a healthier planet and stronger communities.
Examples: climate, sustainability, agriculture, disaster response, smart cities, social impact.
Health, Wellness & Care
Build AI solutions that improve health, wellbeing, and quality of life.
Examples: healthcare, fitness, nutrition, mental wellness, elder care.
Education, Learning & Research
Build AI solutions that make learning, education, and research better.
Examples: tutoring, personalized learning, professional training, research, career development.
Business, Growth & Productivity
Build AI solutions that help businesses work smarter, grow faster, and operate better.
Examples: sales, marketing, CRM, analytics, productivity, automation, business operations.
Media, Entertainment & Creators
Build AI solutions for creativity, entertainment, and digital experiences.
Examples: film, music, gaming, content creation, creator tools, social media.
Commerce, Retail & Consumer
Build AI solutions that transform how people shop and how businesses sell.
Examples: e-commerce, marketplaces, retail, logistics, inventory, personalized shopping.
Build the Future
Whether you're creating a climate startup, an AI health company, an education platform, a new media studio, or an autonomous business operating system, the goal is the same:
Build a company where a team of AI agents can turn an idea into reality.
Come celebrate, build, experiment, and show us what the future of business looks like.

About Event

​Build a Sovereign AI Model Factory: an ML Engineer Agent that evaluates, fine-tunes, deploys, and improves open models using Union on your cloud.

​The best AI teams aren't renting every capability from an external API, they're building systems they own and control. In this hands-on session at the AWS Loft, we'll build exactly that.

​We'll start with a walkthrough where we build a LangGraph-powered agent that evaluates open models in parallel, fine-tunes promising candidates, deploys the winner, and retrains automatically when performance drops. Think of it as the first brick in your own model factory: a repeatable system for evaluating, improving, and deploying models you control, not a black box you call and hope for the best.

​Along the way, you'll see how Union.ai gives your workflows a durable runtime with infrastructure as context, so agents adapt infra resources, recover from failures, and keep moving without re-running completed work. And because it all runs in your own AWS account, you own the full stack end to end: your models, your data, your infrastructure, your IP.

​Then we switch into hack night mode: keep building on the example, bring your own models or datasets, experiment with evals and fine-tuning, extend open models to different parts of your agent, or start something new around the same ideas.

​For teams thinking about sovereign AI, this is a practical starting point for owning more of your stack, the weights, the training loop, the evals, and the infrastructure it runs on, all on AWS.

​Bring a laptop. Leave with a factory.
